name: Datadog APM
summary: Datadog APM is priced per host. The standalone plans cost $36, $41 and $47 per host a month on annual billing for APM, APM Pro and APM Enterprise. Each APM host includes 150 GB of ingested spans and 1 million indexed spans, and extra ingestion costs $0.10 per GB.

facts.text: The base APM tier includes distributed tracing, automatic service discovery and dependency mapping, 15 days of historical trace search, and request, error and duration metrics based on 100% of traffic with 15 months of retention.
Data Streams Monitoring is added in APM Pro, and the Continuous Profiler is added in APM Enterprise.
Different APM tiers cannot be mixed under one commitment.

plans.name: APM
plans.notes: Standalone, billed annually. Listed at $31 when bought with Infrastructure Monitoring. 150 GB of ingested spans and 1 million indexed spans per host a month

plans.name: APM Pro
plans.notes: Standalone, billed annually. Listed at $35 with Infrastructure Monitoring. Adds Data Streams Monitoring

plans.name: APM Enterprise
plans.notes: Standalone, billed annually. Listed at $40 with Infrastructure Monitoring. Adds the Continuous Profiler

hiddenCosts: Ingested spans beyond the included 150 GB per host cost $0.10 per GB.
Indexed spans beyond the included amount are priced by retention period, for example $1.70 per million for 15 days on annual billing.
On-demand rates are higher than annual rates, for example $36 against $31 for APM bought with Infrastructure Monitoring.
The page lists a free trial button for each tier but does not state the trial length.
